title: Fireworks authorization for city-initiated events
subtitle: Short special meeting also covered an earlier start time, a regional joint council meeting and a closed session.
overview: Kitchener's special council meeting was brief, starting at 4:41 p.m. instead of the posted 5:00 p.m. and adjourning at 4:47 p.m. Council first waived notice so the meeting could start early {{vote:m1}}.

The main decision was to authorize the Mayor and Clerk, or a General Manager, to sign pyrotechnic and firework permit documents consenting to firework displays on City property for city-initiated events {{vote:m2}}. The documents must satisfy the City Solicitor. This gives staff a clear process for approving displays at events the City runs, as set out in report DSD-2024-291. The Director of Culture and Entertainment was available to answer questions.

Council also agreed to hold a closed session after the meeting on a solicitor-client privilege matter {{vote:m3}}. The minutes report no outcome from it. The acting mayor noted that members of council are invited to a joint meeting with Region of Waterloo council and all area municipalities on Friday, June 21, 2024 at 2:00 p.m. No pecuniary interests were declared.

decisions.detail: Council authorized the Mayor and Clerk or a General Manager to sign permit documents consenting to firework displays on City property for city-initiated events, to the City Solicitor's satisfaction {{vote:m2}}.
Council waived notice so the special meeting could begin earlier than the posted 5:00 p.m. start time {{vote:m1}}.
